newsitem.title: USA: Aquila offers small shareholders selling program.
newsitem.headline: Aquila offers small shareholders selling program.

text.p: Aquila Biopharmaceuticals, Inc. announced Tuesday that it has initiated a small shareholder selling program aimed at those who received their odd lots as part of a class action settlement.
Shareholders owning less than 100 shares of common stock will dispose of their shares free of transaction and odd-lot fees, the company said.

Aquila estimates that more than 65 percent of its shareholders hold less than 100 shares for a total of approximately 420,000 shares of the common stock, or about 8.0 percent of the 5 million shares outstanding.

Aquila is a successor to Cambridge Biotech Corporation. Many of the Aquila odd-lot shareholders received their shares through the distribution of Aquila stock as settlement of the class action lawsuit against Cambridge Biotech, a spokesman for the Worcester, Mass.-based company said..
The program will run from June 27, 1997 to August 15, 1997 and may be extended.
Aquila has retained the Herman Group, Inc. to assist shareholders and Josephthal, Lyon and Ross, Inc. is acting as a selling agent.
Inquiries should be directed to The Herman Group, Inc., 2121 San Jacinto Street, 26th Floor, Dallas, Texas; Telephone: 800-555-5468.
